invoice-match-demo/step_segmentation/ste.name: Review an invoice against its purchase order
invoice-match-demo/step_segmentation/ste.goal: Compare the selected invoice total with its purchase order total, approve a match, and flag a mismatch for attention.

steps.intent: Compare the selected invoice and purchase order totals
expects: The comparison result states whether the totals match

steps.intent: Approve the invoice when the totals match

decisions.condition: The invoice total matches the purchase order total shown on screen

evidence.description: The user explicitly described the Approve invoice and Flag difference outcomes.
The recorded matching path clicked Approve invoice and confirmed the Approved state.

else.description: Click Flag difference and confirm the review state shows Needs attention.
